Vendored xterm.js, served by AIB from this folder (no CDN). Files are unmodified copies from the npm packages.
Licenses: MIT (LICENSE, LICENSE-addon-fit, LICENSE-addon-canvas).

@xterm/xterm         5.5.0   lib/xterm.js          -> xterm.js
                             css/xterm.css         -> xterm.css
@xterm/addon-fit     0.10.0  lib/addon-fit.js      -> addon-fit.js
@xterm/addon-canvas  0.7.0   lib/addon-canvas.js   -> addon-canvas.js

The canvas renderer is used because xterm's default DOM renderer inserts <style> elements, which the page's
Content-Security-Policy (style-src 'self') blocks. The addon is loaded before Terminal.open(), so the DOM renderer is never made.
